identity_policy.acceptance: Accepted battle, adventure and portrait assets require checksum-bound native-size identity review under assets/reviews.
identity_policy.rule: Independent Piltovan Wardens, academy bolt crews, non-living freight handlers, armored arcane Stompers, flying hextech Rotorwings and original quadrupedal hextech beasts. Base roster: four walking-melee, two finite physical ranged and one flying-melee line; upgrades: three walking-melee, three finite physical ranged and one flying-melee line. Stompers cast finite action-cost Shield; only the upgraded apex shoots six physical bolts. Regional recruitment and engineering roles are documented adaptations, never mass-produced champions, literal TFT copies or recolored original troops.

original_resource_references: Structure and rendering language only: original Heroes III creature, town and siege layouts measured for scale.
release_policy: Every required output needs an approved source, a recorded checksum, redistribution rights and native-size visual acceptance. No placeholders.
visual_direction: Painted 2D original Heroes III compatibility; inhabited ivory-stone and weathered-bronze trade terraces, timber, navy/teal cloth and restrained blue hextech. Plan dry foundations, doors and roads together with full building footprints; larger apparent foreground services frame physically monumental rear guilds. Correct Piltover crests on credible material surfaces.
